items.special_treatment: For lysate catalysis, 50 g/L whole cells were pre-treated with 3.2 mL of 1 g/L lysozyme solution at 37°C for 1 hr. For post-processing, after reaction completion, 1.8 kg ethyl acetate was added, stirred for 1 hr, centrifuged at 1000 rpm to remove insoluble protein and salts, and phases separated after 3 hrs. Organic phase concentrated to 0.5 volume, then 4× heptane added under 200 rpm stirring. Product precipitated, collected by filtration, and rinsed three times by heptane.
items.treatment_procedure: Screening: 96-well plates, 50 g/L wet cell, 10 mM cyclohexene oxide, 20 mM NaOCN, 200 μL PB buffer (50 mM, pH 7.0), 35°C, 16 hrs. Reaction mixture extracted with 600 μL ethyl acetate. For whole cell catalysis: 5 mL reactions, different cyclohexene oxide amounts, 2 eq NaOCN, 35% (v/v) co-solvent, 16 hrs, HBC extracted with 10 mL ethyl acetate, organic phase diluted for GC. For lysate catalysis: see above. Pilot-scale: 50 L reactor, 13.2 kg water, 7.5 kg ethyl acetate, 0.48 kg cyclohexene oxide, 0.6 kg NaOCN, 1.2 kg wet cell, 25°C, 29 hrs. Post-processing: see above.
